task: Add background removal (person segmentation) to an existing Android app, on the GPU

model.input: [1, 3, 1024, 1024] float32 NCHW, RGB, x/255, image stretched to the square (no letterbox)
model.output: [1, 1, 1024, 1024] float32 sigmoid matte; min-max normalized per image, 1 = subject

patches: F.interpolate align_corners=True -> False on the bilinear upsamples (the GPU delegate rejects align_corners=True)
convert.reproduced: 2026-09-05: re-run with litert-torch 0.9.4 and torch 2.13.0 produced a byte-identical file (same sha256)

integrate.model_delivery: bundled as app/src/main/assets/ormbg.tflite (gitignored); BgRemover.fromFile(path) for a file staged into filesDir is exercised by the same test

verify.expected: BUILD SUCCESSFUL, 3 tests passed. logcat: 'Replacing 246 out of 246 node(s) with delegate (LITERT_CL) node, yielding 1 partitions for subgraph 0 (main).' and 'RESULT device=Pixel 8a sdk=36 accel=GPU load_ms=2566 model_ms_median=246 process_ms_median=361 runs=20 raw_min=0.0000 raw_max=1.0000 mean=0.5208 fg_frac=0.5213 center=1.0000 corners=0.0001 thermal=0->0'. Asserted: raw range > 0.5, center > 0.9, corners < 0.1, fg_frac and mean within +-0.02 of the recorded values, cutout alpha transparent at the corner and opaque at the center. Latency and load are logged conditions, not assertions.
verify.host_parity: scripts/verify_device_dump.py on the input tensor the test fed the model: device GPU fp16 vs host CPU fp32, raw-output corr 1.000000, max |diff| 0.00905, foreground-mask IoU 0.99997 (2026-09-05)

devices.name: Pixel 8a
devices.conditions: screen on, USB connected, battery 100 %, nothing else running; medians over 20 calls after warm-up; last of five runs in a row (model median 241-249 ms across the five)
devices.parity: raw corr 1.000000, max |diff| 0.00905 vs host CPU fp32 on the identical input
devices.source: this recipe's verify command, run on 2026-09-05
